summary: Update Compliance Document to have clickable links?
notes: The client change keeps PDF annotation rendering enabled, automatically opens PDF links, and locks annotations so the viewer remains read-only. No application route, document fixture, link label, destination URL, or server endpoint was supplied. Browser verification of actual link navigation is therefore MANUAL_REQUIRED until a Compliance Document route and a document containing a grounded native PDF link are available. Unauthenticated browser coverage is not included because the browser runner does not support unauthenticated execution.

browserCases.goal: Verify that the Compliance Document is available in the read-only PDF viewer configured to preserve clickable native PDF link annotations.
browserCases.successCriteria: The required Compliance Document route and PDF fixture must be provided. The document should render in the PDF viewer without undefined or null data. MANUAL_REQUIRED: open a grounded native link in the rendered PDF and verify that it navigates to its intended destination while annotation editing or selection remains unavailable.
